key.name: recent
key.description: The apps used most, in a row at the top of the app grid, under "Recently used", with "All apps" over the grid.

key.name: order
key.description: custom: GNOME's own, where you put each icon. name: A to Z. use: the apps used most first, by GNOME's own record of use. kind: by what each app says it is, then A to Z. Your folders come first in every order but custom, and what you arranged by hand is kept for custom.

key.name: hidden
key.summary: Apps hidden from the grid and the search
key.description: Launcher IDs (name.desktop) kept out of the app grid, its folders and the search. A hidden app still opens from a terminal and from Open With, and stays in the dock if it is pinned there. No launcher is written for it.

key.name: names
key.description: A launcher ID and the name shown under its icon instead of its own, 64 characters at most. Only the label changes.

key.name: icons
key.description: A launcher ID and the icon shown for it: the name of an installed Amethystora icon pack (amethystora-neon...), whose drawing of the app is used, or picture:N, a picture of your own that amethystora-app-look wrote into ~/.local/share/amethystora/app-icons.
